analysis:
On 30 July 2026 the Assam Chief Minister announced that Aadhaar-seeded transfers under the state's Orunodoi scheme would resume from 1 August 2026, with 37.1 lakh women beneficiaries receiving ₹1,250 per month.

ANI, the Financial Express and Mint reported the same figures. Prasar Bharati (NewsOnAir) reported the launch of the Orunodoi 3.0 disbursement, describing monthly financial assistance transferred to more than 37 lakh women through DBT.

The beneficiary count and monthly amount in the claim match the figures carried in these reports.
notes: The claim is a statement of fact about scheme beneficiaries rather than a policy promise, so no deadline applies. Beneficiary counts are state government figures reported by multiple outlets; they are not independently audited. The scheme was launched in 2020 and payments had been paused during floods before resuming in August 2026. LiveMint publication date not confirmed.
